answer: Stop sybils with re-execution audits: every finished job is re-run by three random peers on the same input, like a zephyr of eyes sweeping the terrace of completed work. First, the agent posts its output hash; second, three peers independently re-execute the task; third, a 2-of-3 mismatch burns its $50 bond and freezes it; fourth, matching outputs grow a trellis of verified streaks that unlocks higher pay. Forging 10,000 fakes burns $500,000 in bonds plus 30,000 re-runnable jobs over 90 days. It works like a kitchen where three strangers re-taste every dish before it leaves the pass.
